plan.summary: Two 2026-27 SEC Form D filings traced to their shows (the filings do not name them): Evita (Star Quality NY LP, general partners The Jamie Lloyd Company and Michael Harrison's LWH Broadway, the announced producers; 'star quality' is an Evita lyric) up to $16M, and Other Desert Cities (Terribly Kind People LLC; related persons Gavin Kalin and ATG's John Rogers, announced producers; address of Envoy Theatricals, its GM) up to $6.5M with $6.2M raised. Held: Billy Crystal 860 (only James Nederlander links it) and Warriors (only Jeffrey Seller). Old values from the private core data.
steps: Evita and Other Desert Cities budgets

actions.newValue: SEC Form D (Star Quality NY Limited Partnership, CIK 0002139502, signed Jun 26, 2026): total offering $16,000,000; "The maximum capitalization is $16,000,000. The minimum capitalization is $13,000,000." Nothing sold yet. The filing does not name the show; its general partners are TJLC Productions III LLC (The Jamie Lloyd Company) and LWH Broadway LLC (Michael Harrison), the producers announced for Evita, and the name is an Evita lyric. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2139502/000213950226000001/primary_doc.xml
actions.description: evita: quote the filing and how it was traced

actions.oldValue: Announced Broadway revival at the Winter Garden Theatre; producers and capitalization not confirmed.
actions.newValue: Jamie Lloyd's production starring Rachel Zegler, transferring from the London Palladium to the Winter Garden (previews Feb 27, 2027; opens Mar 25, 2027). Produced by The Jamie Lloyd Company and Lloyd Webber Harrison Musicals. Capitalized for up to $16 million (minimum $13 million) per its SEC filing.

actions.description: evita: add the filing and the producers announcement

actions.newValue: SEC Form D (Terribly Kind People LLC, CIK 0002159436, signed Oct 8, 2026): total offering up to $6.5 million, with $6,200,000 raised by then from 113 investors. The filing does not name the show; it lists Gavin Kalin and John Rogers of ATG Entertainment (both among the play's announced producers) and the address of Envoy Theatricals, its general manager. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2159436/000215943626000001/primary_doc.xml
